en.title: AcrossVAM1.0: Particle World Modeling for Text-Assisted Robot Video Prediction
en.hook: Discover a novel architecture that decouples motion reasoning from high-frequency appearance preservation in robot video forecasting.
key_takeaways: Resolves the entanglement of motion and appearance in monolithic pixel models
Leverages text assistance for precise robot video prediction
Applies particle-based world modeling for efficient physical interaction simulation

zh.title: AcrossVAM1.0：用于文本辅助机器人视频预测的粒子世界模型
zh.hook: 了解这一创新架构，它解耦了机器人视频预测中的运动推理与高频外观保持，显著提升准确率。
key_takeaways: 解决了单体像素模型中运动与外观交织的局限性
利用文本辅助信息实现精准的机器人视频预测
通过基于粒子的世界模型进行高效的物理交互模拟
